segments.text: Wait, wait, wait—listen to me.
segments.acting_note: Nemi's eyes dart from off-screen directly into camera lens. 2-frame blink.

segments.text: Please stop scrolling for literally two seconds.
segments.acting_note: Left hand raises slightly, leaning forward 15px.

segments.text: Look at this drawing right here.
segments.acting_note: Flat horizontal mouth line, eyes glance down at drawing, then back to viewer.

segments.text: It is supposed to be a hand holding a teacup. It looks like an angry ginger root.
segments.acting_note: Tiny corner mouth twitch, slight head tilt.

segments.text: Hi. I’m Nemi. I’m 24.
segments.acting_note: Warm, upright posture, soft coral cheek blush, head tilts 8 degrees right.

segments.text: And apparently... I am making animated YouTube videos now.
segments.acting_note: Right eyebrow arches, sheepish half-smile, shoulders shrug subtly.

segments.text: I’ve spent years watching storytime creators talk about their lives, and recently my brain had a terrible idea:
segments.acting_note: Eyes look upward in thought, hand taps chin playfully.

segments.text: 'How hard could that possibly be?'
segments.acting_note: Puffs chest out, confident smug smile, sparkle highlight in eyes.

segments.text: As it turns out: extraordinarily hard.
segments.acting_note: Instant 0-frame posture drop. Shoulders curl forward, arms hang limp.

segments.text: Nobody warns you that twenty-four frames a second just means twenty-four individual chances to humiliate yourself every single second.
segments.acting_note: Head shakes slowly, hand comes up to cover eyes with fingers parted.

segments.text: I spent four hours yesterday inbetweening an arm movement. And by the end of it, my character wasn't walking.
segments.acting_note: Looking down at digital stylus prop in hand with deep skepticism.

segments.text: It looked like they were slipping on three invisible banana peels.
segments.acting_note: Look snaps directly into camera lens. Total stillness.

segments.text: ...In slow motion.
segments.acting_note: Flat deadpan stare. Minimal mouth movement.

segments.text: And look—normally, when I’m not breaking my wrist over a drawing tablet, I have a very disciplined routine.
segments.acting_note: Upright posture, counting on fingers.

segments.text: I go to the gym. Where I walk in with the confidence of an anime hero in a tournament arc... and walk out two sets later completely paralyzed by leg day.
segments.acting_note: Heroic chest puff -> instant trembling legs and hunched spine. Doodle: *DOMS ACTIVATED*

segments.text: I watch way too much anime. Like—the kind where you say 'just one episode before bed,' and suddenly birds are chirping outside and you have a master's degree in fictional dragon politics.
segments.acting_note: Eyes wide with dark exhaustion rings, holding a stack of books with rapid page flutters.

segments.text: And I sing. Mostly in my car with the windows rolled up.
segments.acting_note: Eyes close passionately, hand on chest, operatic stance.

segments.text: ...Except last Tuesday when the window was not rolled up, and a mail carrier heard me hit a high G with absolute vibrato.
segments.acting_note: Head turns sharply left. Eyes wide. Freezes in mortification.

segments.text: So why am I doing this? Because I have all these weird, hyper-specific situations that happen in my life, and keeping them inside my brain feels dangerous.
segments.acting_note: Gestures with both hands, leaning in conspiratorially.

segments.text: Like last week, when I spent six entire hours researching the exact structural tension of Victorian iron bridges...
segments.acting_note: Frantic typing doodle hands in front of chest.

segments.text: ...just to draw one single background that is on screen for half a second.
segments.acting_note: Eyes narrow, staring straight at viewer. Subtitle clears.

segments.text: Half. A. Second.
segments.acting_note: Completely rigid statue hold. Zero breathing. Pupils contract.

segments.text: ...My posture was ruined. My tea was ice cold. But the bridge was architecturally sound.
segments.acting_note: Subtle, self-satisfied nod, followed by an immediate weary eye-roll.

segments.text: So this channel is going to be stories about things that happen to me—the awkward encounters, the creative rabbit holes, the gym blunders, and whatever else I end up drawing along the way.
segments.acting_note: Fluid hand gestures, relaxed shoulders, eyes tracking naturally.

segments.text: I don’t really know where this channel is going yet, but I want to have fun with it, get better at animation, and hopefully meet some cool people.
segments.acting_note: Gentle smile, soft head tilt, open welcoming expression.

segments.text: So, if any of that sounds like something you’d enjoy... I’d love it if you stayed.
segments.acting_note: Soft, sincere eye contact with viewer.

segments.text: Also—straighten your posture right now. Yes, you. I know how you’re sitting.
segments.acting_note: Leans forward, points index finger right down the camera barrel with mock-strict expression.

segments.text: Thank you for watching my very first video. See you in the next one. Bye!
segments.acting_note: Casual friendly two-finger wave, head tilts happily.

segments.text: Wait—did I leave the microphone gain at two hundred percent?!
segments.acting_note: Chibi Nemi's eyes are wide white spirals with streaming tear lines.

segments.text: Oh no, please tell me I didn't—was my breathing recorded the entire—
...It was. Cool.
